summary: All five targets share one shape: each already reaches OUT to its real neighbors — Audition Gate names Phoneme Choir and Talking Keyboard as its evidence, Quadratic Interpolation in DSP (QID) spawned Compressor Design and connects to Differential Equations/Latent Error/Portamento, SMPTE LTC deepens Boundary-Crossing Instruments and ties itself to Frequency-Time Duality, Slime Mold Delay names Biomechanical Synthesis as its parent hub and Particle Synthesis as its population-based sibling, Tract Mirror names Linear Predictive Coding and Waveguide Synthesizer as the mirrors-pair it makes literal — but none of those neighbors link back. The zero-inbound count wasn't a sign of isolation; it was one-way roads on genuinely well-chosen streets. The strongest finds were the ones where a target's own body had already done the analytical work and just hadn't been echoed: Biomechanical Synthesis' "eight instruments" hub not yet listing Slime Mold Delay as the fifth spawned instrument even though the entry says so explicitly; Linear Predictive Coding already carrying the exact mirrors claim ("scattering-junction-is-the-vocal-tract") that Tract Mirror goes on to build as hardware-in-a-DAW; Frequency-Time Duality's perceptual reciprocal-axis principle showing up again, restated as engineering, inside SMPTE LTC. One structural surprise: Quadratic Interpolation in DSP has no forward_vector field at all, unusual for a "growing" entry with this much developed content. Another: Tract Mirror is staged "seed" despite being a shipped, Ableton-verified VST3/AU plugin — worth a second look by whoever owns stage calls.

walk_results.note: Its own body already names Phoneme Choir and Talking Keyboard as the two concrete failures that proved the practice; neither links back. Stage (seed, self-marked 'Section seed' throughout) and forward_vector both still fit.

QID spawned Compressor Design but Compressor Design never says emerged-from back; Differential Equations, Latent Error, and Portamento are all named in QID's own 'Related Concepts' section without a reciprocal; Exponential Decay Curvature (hop2) is an unnamed structural mirror — same closed-form-curvature-control move in a different domain. Flag: QID has no forward_vector field at all, unusual for stage=growing with this much developed content.

Frequency-Time Duality's own claim (a continuous parameter reads as different perceptual experience depending on where you sit on the axis) is exactly what SMPTE LTC's body restates as engineering ('every bit transition is a frequency/phase event') — genuinely reciprocal, not yet wired. Boundary-Crossing Instruments, Modes of Collaboration, and Signal-Rate CV Architecture were checked and are too general / not textually grounded enough to force a reciprocal (BCI already carries 37 inbound of this shape).

Its body states outright it 'is the first concrete development of one of the eight Biomechanical Synthesis instruments' — the hub hasn't listed it as spawned yet (Action Potential Oscillator is, by the same hub, with the same type). Particle Synthesis is named as its population-based sibling but doesn't point back. Hyperdimensional Prism / Kuramoto Coupling / Spinoza Conatus / Substrate Skill are all major hubs (40–72 inbound) already carrying this shape of relation from many entries — reciprocal would be forced there, skipped.

Linear Predictive Coding already carries the mirrors claim ('scattering-junction-is-the-vocal-tract') that Tract Mirror executes as hardware; Waveguide Synthesizer is the named mirrors-sibling (tube vs string) with no return link; Three.js already uses a 'commissioned-by' pattern for Waveguide Synthesizer and should carry the same for Tract Mirror, whose GUI literally is a WKWebView running three.js. Flag: stage=seed undersells a shipped, Ableton-verified VST3/AU plugin.

typed_relations.label: syllabification-finding-via-listening
typed_relations.evidence: "Phoneme Choir: Kokoro syllabified words differently than the spec assumed; only audition caught the mismatch." — Audition Gate.md
typed_relations.rationale: Audition Gate already emerged-from Phoneme Choir with this exact label; the reciprocal spawned link belongs in Phoneme Choir's own frontmatter, matching the palace's existing convention (e.g. Generative Sample Libraries spawned / Phoneme Choir emerged-from).

typed_relations.label: pronunciation-finding-via-listening
typed_relations.evidence: "Talking Keyboard: pronunciation of 'eight' required spelling as 'eigh' — audition was how this was discovered." — Audition Gate.md
typed_relations.rationale: Same pairing as Phoneme Choir; Audition Gate names this specific finding as one of its two founding examples.

typed_relations.label: soft-knee-is-quadratic
typed_relations.evidence: "This is literally quadratic interpolation from 'no change to input' to 'full compression ratio applied.'" — Quadratic Interpolation in DSP.md
typed_relations.rationale: QID's own frontmatter already has spawned → Compressor Design; the missing half is Compressor Design pointing back, per the same lineage-pair convention seen elsewhere in the palace.

typed_relations.label: smoothing-as-de-solution
typed_relations.evidence: "Smooth interpolation functions are solutions to differential equations. A quadratic ramp is approximating an exponential approach." — Quadratic Interpolation in DSP.md
typed_relations.rationale: QID names this connection directly in its own Related Concepts section; DE's frontmatter doesn't return it.

typed_relations.label: interpolation-choice-as-error-or-character
typed_relations.evidence: "This connects to Latent Error: is using the 'wrong' interpolation method a latent design error, or is it a creative choice that adds character?" — Quadratic Interpolation in DSP.md
typed_relations.rationale: QID poses this as an open, load-bearing question about Latent Error's own diagnostic frame; genuine two-way relevance.

typed_relations.label: glide-interpolation-choice
typed_relations.evidence: "Pitch movement during a glide is a choice of interpolation function. Linear, exponential, or quadratic? Each sounds different and maps onto different physical models." — Quadratic Interpolation in DSP.md
typed_relations.rationale: QID's Related Concepts section treats Portamento as a direct application case; Portamento doesn't reciprocate.

typed_relations.label: closed-form-curvature-control
typed_relations.evidence: "the curvature control found on synth envelopes... sweeps a decay from convex through linear to concave while holding total decay time fixed — admits a clean closed form" — Exponential Decay Curvature.md, vs. QID's "the control point... 'pulls' the curve toward itself, controlling the curvature."
typed_relations.rationale: Same pattern (a closed-form parameter that bends a curve's shape while holding its endpoints fixed), different material — an envelope-decay law vs. a Bezier/quadratic interpolant. Neither entry currently names the other; a genuine hop2 find, not textually stated anywhere yet.

typed_relations.label: engineered-vs-perceptual-axis
typed_relations.evidence: "It is also deeply tied to Frequency-Time Duality: LTC is literally the time axis encoded in frequency space. Every bit transition is a frequency/phase event. Reading LTC is a frequency-domain act that yields time-domain information." — SMPTE LTC.md
typed_relations.rationale: Frequency-Time Duality's core claim (f = 1/T, one continuous axis reads as different phenomena depending on where you sit) reappears here as an engineered protocol instead of a perceptual continuum. SMPTE LTC connects-to FTD already; FTD doesn't point back, and the relationship is closer to mirrors than plain connects-to — same reciprocal math, different material (ear vs. protocol).

typed_relations.label: instrument-05
typed_relations.evidence: "This entry is the first concrete development of one of the eight Biomechanical Synthesis instruments. The hub diagram lists it; this entry is its body." — Slime Mold Delay.md
typed_relations.rationale: Biomechanical Synthesis already spawned → Action Potential Oscillator (instrument-01, presumably) with this type; Slime Mold Delay states its own parentage explicitly but the hub hasn't caught up.

typed_relations.label: population-based-emergence-sibling
typed_relations.evidence: "The metaphor connects directly to Particle Synthesis — both are population-based instruments where individual elements have no intelligence and the system has plenty." — Slime Mold Delay.md
typed_relations.rationale: Slime Mold Delay deepens Particle Synthesis already; this additional, more specific kinship (emergent behavior from unintelligent populations) is named in the body and unreturned. Particle Synthesis is dormant — a live sibling pointing in gives it a current thread to follow.

typed_relations.label: mirror-made-playable
typed_relations.evidence: LPC already carries "mirrors → Waveguide Synthesizer, label: scattering-junction-is-the-vocal-tract"; Tract Mirror's own thesis line: "the LPC lattice filter's reflection coefficients are the impedance mismatches between successive tube segments... executed."
typed_relations.rationale: Tract Mirror emerged-from LPC already (twice, with two labels); LPC doesn't return it. Tract Mirror is the literal, playable execution of a claim LPC already makes in the abstract.

typed_relations.label: the-string-to-its-tube
typed_relations.evidence: "Where the Waveguide Synthesizer renders the string body of this mathematics in the browser, Tract Mirror renders the tube body — and steps out of the browser into Ableton Live." — Tract Mirror.md
typed_relations.rationale: Tract Mirror mirrors → Waveguide Synthesizer already (the-tube-to-its-string); this is a genuine symmetric pair named explicitly as siblings, and Waveguide Synthesizer's own frontmatter doesn't carry it back.

typed_relations.label: commissioned-by
typed_relations.evidence: "JUCE 8 + WebView GUI — C++ DSP core; the GUI is a WKWebView running three.js." — Tract Mirror.md; Three.js already uses label commissioned-by for Waveguide Synthesizer.
typed_relations.rationale: Same relationship, same label pattern Three.js already uses for its other browser-rendered instrument commission; Tract Mirror is simply missing from that same roster.
